long_biography.plain_text:
Daniel Birmann's most durable industrial role has been within CBC Global Ammunition, where he has held managerial positions for several decades as part of the shareholding family. The group expanded beyond its Brazilian cartridge business through manufacturing operations in the United States, Germany, Belgium and India, while also taking control of firearms maker Taurus.

A strategic exchange in 2024 reshaped that portfolio. CBC sold Czech ammunition manufacturer Sellier & Bellot to Colt CZ Group and received a substantial minority stake in the listed buyer, becoming its second-largest shareholder. Birmann joined Colt CZ's supervisory board as CBC's representative, giving the family a formal governance role in the combined international defence group.
